description: Upstream test isolation gap: InstallAppState::for_test sets FABRO_TEST_IN_MEMORY_STORE=1 process-wide via unsafe set_var and NEVER restores it. Any test running after an install-flow test in the same binary gets its LocalFileSystem object store silently swapped to InMemory — write_artifact_store_metadata fails NoDataInMemory{store-metadata.json}, serve::build_object_store/slatedb fail the same way. Solo passes, suite fails: env-leak signature. Also: SVG render tests (server::tests::get_graph_returns_svg +2) need target/debug/fabro built (render_graph_subprocess_exe spawns it) — cargo test alone never builds the bin; build -p fabro-cli --bin fabro first.
resolution: Pin FABRO_TEST_IN_MEMORY_STORE=0 at test start, restore/remove via Drop guard (#[expect(unsafe_code)] on Drop impl, same allowance as for_test_with_paths). For SVG tests: cargo build -p fabro-cli --bin fabro before the suite. Guards drafted on denkhaus (uncommitted) in install.rs around line 2596.

name: develop-workflow-architecture
description: Develop workflow on meta/denkhaus-lab (canonical, synced to lab via sync-check.nu): 8 nodes — planner (high), implementer (low), tester (just qualitygate), evidence (complete capture: blobref-resolve, source-before-docs), reviewer (agent node, low, tools), closeout (deterministic script: sd close + tracker check via output_schema=routing preferred_next_label). Graph: cycle_counter_reset_key=current_seed_id injects seed_cycles; STRUCTURAL guards as edge conditions (reviewer->exit kind=deadlock at seed_cycles.reviewer>=3, tester->exit at >=3, evidence re-capture bounded by seed_cycles.evidence<2) — conditions outrank unconditional edges so termination needs no model compliance. Exit kinds classify terminal events: deadlock=FailureReason::Deadlock (human decides), soft=SoftStop (re-enter). Journals: per-run JSONL (.fabro/journal/<run_id>.jsonl, run-local visits, newline-repair append). Planner never closes seeds (closeout does), never acts on approved verdicts; implementer forbidden from running the gate. ADR-0009/0010 on meta document decisions.

title: Journals are per-run JSONL streams
rationale: auto-PR merge-back must never conflict on journal files; parallel/sequential runs from one base stay independent

title: Post-approval bookkeeping is deterministic (closeout)
rationale: LLM-performed deterministic bookkeeping wastes a session per seed and mis-executes; routing on tracker state must be structural

name: develop-run-economics
description: Measured develop-run economics (first auto-merge run): total ~bash.35/seed cycle. implementer bash.109/125s (48%) — reasoning low pinned after 8.2k reasoning tokens for a resolved brief; planner@2 (pre-closeout) was bash.021/21s pure bookkeeping — removed by closeout node; reviewer bash.059 with 3.4k reasoning tokens — low pinned with revert contract. Cache discipline: 536k cache-read vs 75k input overall, but cache_write=0 everywhere (each stage repays the ~4-5k system+tools+skills prefix — fabro-944d open). ~40 skills injected per stage (~1.5k tokens each), zero activated — skill_dirs filter is upstream PR #751. Triple gate eliminated by prompt rule. Slack terminal route in project.toml (run.notifications.terminal -> #fabro-reviews, events run.completed/run.failed).

name: develop-asset-map
description: Key assets: meta/denkhaus-lab .fabro/workflows/develop/ (workflow.fabro 8 nodes/20 edges, prompts/{planner,implementer,reviewer}.md, scripts/{evidence,stage-journal,closeout,sync-check}.nu) + docs/adr/0009-0010 + CONTEXT.md vocab. Engine features on denkhaus: seed_cycles injection (cycle_counter_reset_key), dotted-path conditions, exit-kind edges (deadlock/soft -> FailureReason), HookContext.context_updates journal bridge, response dedup (compact_response_value at output.<node>), display_image for sandbox.initialized, PR-model config [run.pull_request]. Platform seeds open: fabro-67e5 (preflight PR-scope probe, in_progress), fabro-944d (cache writes), fabro-f251/176b/6a78 (upstream offering, hooks, compact-fidelity context_updates).

GitHub API rejects UA-less requests with 403 (administrative rules). The fabro-67e5 preflight REST probe shipped without a User-Agent and reported 'scope mismatch' on a perfectly good fine-grained PAT — while the same token worked for git push AND manual API calls. Symptom signature: token works everywhere except ONE new REST call -> check that call's headers, not the token. Every fabro-github REST call sends 'User-Agent: fabro' (lib.rs:496, 1036); any new REST call must too. Debug path that cracked it: extract vault token from /storage/db/fabro.sqlite3 (secrets table, plaintext), direct curl with/without UA -> 403 vs 200.
resolution: Add .header("User-Agent", "fabro") to the probe (commit 151833ede on denkhaus); live-verified preflight now reports 'pull-requests scope verified against the REST API'.

description: GitHub auto-merge only ENGAGES when the target branch has required status checks (branch protection). The fork's run branches have 'no checks reported', so [run.pull_request] auto_merge=true opened PRs #1/#2 with auto-merge:disabled forever — runs read succeeded while PRs rotted open; both needed manual merge/close. Root cause is repo-side config, not engine code.
resolution: Short term: manual squash-merge (gh pr merge N --squash --delete-branch) then pull. Durable: seed fabro-ab2c on denkhaus — add a trivial required check workflow + branch protection on denkhaus-lab, or server-side direct-merge fallback when no checks exist.

name: run-01M0TXPX-validation
description: Run 01M0TXPX validated the full new architecture live in ONE run: 2 complete seed cycles (fabro-cfb6 -seed flag, fabro-d920 -format flag with shortcut-conflict rejection), 14 journal lines in ONE JSONL, deterministic closeout closed both cycles (no planner bookkeeping visit), zero deadlocks/verification-blocks. Cost: 7 stages 9m29s $0.60 (planner $0.09 = two claims). PR #2 body confirmed stage table + diff stats render correctly. Remaining rough edges: PR content fell back to deterministic title (fabro-21c1: glm-4.7 PR-model call fails at publish), auto-merge never engaged (fabro-ab2c), all 14 journal lines had painpoints=[] (fabro-e7c4: explicit none convention).

title: Keep fork exit kinds; do not adopt upstream on_failure=exit in develop
rationale: on_failure=exit only blocks the unconditional fallback for failed nodes; develop routes every failure explicitly and its exit kinds (deadlock/soft) classify the terminal event with richer semantics than upstream's generic stopped-routing failure. PR #803 (model test --tools/--reasoning-effort) obsoleted none of our seeds.

name: preamble-inline-max-resolution
description: preamble_inline_max_kb (fabro-9467): per-value inline ceiling for prompt nodes without tools. Resolution order node attr > graph attr > 8KB default (fabro-types getters). The demote pass takes inline_max as a param (artifact.rs); the aggregate preamble_budget_kb STILL bounds the sum — raise both when inlining fat values, lint preamble_inline_max_within_budget warns on mismatch. Values >=100KB are blob refs before assembly: no ceiling can inline them. Robust preamble test assertions: use preamble length (>9KB proves inline) and marker text ('full value:'), NOT substring runs — the 300-char demote preview contains any 256-char run of a homogeneous value.

title: Stage envelope family contract (ADR-0009)
rationale: One vocabulary and default posture for all per-node restriction seeds prevents drifting conventions; individual delivery keeps each seed shippable per ADR-0008.

description: Integration detection after GitHub AUTO-MERGE must be TREE-BASED, never ancestry-based: auto-merge SQUASHES the run branch into the base (run 01M11P68SHF -> merge commit 5f953db8, single parent), so merge-base --is-ancestor <run-branch> origin/<base> is structurally ALWAYS false after integration. run_workflow.nu polled is-ancestor, always missed the landed merge, fell into the squash fallback, and the fallback's push rejected non-fast-forward against origin's squash -> ALARM exit BEFORE the improve-review step (review silently skipped).
resolution: Fixed 2026-08-27 in 8de2dcde8: poll git diff --quiet <run-branch> origin/<base> (tree equality) instead of is-ancestor, plus push-rejection recovery that re-checks tree equality, resets to origin, and continues to the review step.

description: PR content generation used the run model instead of the dedicated [run.pull_request] model from Aug 24 (a1e27c9bf) to Aug 27: publish.rs consumed the fallback field pr_model while the correctly-resolved pr_resolved_model was never read by production code. Symptom: deterministic fallback PR bodies on every run; one lucky glm-5.3 JSON success (PR #7) masked it as an intermittent provider issue.
resolution: Root-caused via server log (model=glm-5.3 + no resolution warning => silent wrong-field path), fixed in dad7332c6 with extraction + sentinel test (verified red on old wiring).

content: Workflow behavior must live in workflow.toml (or server-managed environments), not project.toml: since upstream v0.345.0-nightly.0 (merge 6530c724f), 'fabro run'/'fabro create' register an immutable workflow version and create runs by intent, and project/CLI-machine [run]+[environments] settings are no longer transmitted — Fabro only warns with affected file/key names. Workflows relying on .fabro/project.toml defaults (e.g. implement-issue's project toolchain environment) silently lose them on manual CLI runs. Server-side automations are unaffected. Run reads build on AppState/Database::load_run_projection (on-demand snapshot-or-replay); cached_run_projection/get_cached_projection are gone.

description: closeout must close the run's seed via stdin_source, never first-in-progress; one seed per run
resolution: Fixed in 4004d198e (closeout stdin_source + one-seed-per-run graph); qualification run pending

description: CI starvation on denkhaus/fabro (fork of fabro-sh/fabro): workflows pinned to runs-on ubuntu-24.04-x86-32-cores (upstream larger-runner pool) never get a runner under the fork - all Rust/TypeScript PR jobs stayed queued forever, so branch-protection required checks never reported and auto-merge starved (PR #16, 56+ min queued).
resolution: PR #17: runs-on ubuntu-24.04 for PR CI (free on public repos, already used by release.yml) and NO paths filter on pull_request triggers - protection requires BOTH Rust+TypeScript, a skipped workflow never reports its check. nightly.yml keeps the upstream label (scheduled workflows disabled on forks anyway).

description: nu 0.115 'input' raises nu::shell::io::uncategorized_error on non-tty (piped) stdin — workflow command scripts that consume stdin_source values must read via 'cat | str join' or 'open --raw /dev/stdin' instead. First live exercise (run 01M1PVMS7B6N39MG0041C5F7P6) crashed the develop closeout.
resolution: closeout.nu reads 'cat | str join' (f7db7d05a); empty-stdin guard keeps exit 1; verified with an sd-shim test harness (pipied seed id -> sd close, empty -> exit 1).

description: GitHub required checks + workflow 'paths:' filters deadlock auto-merge: a PR whose diff matches no path (tracker/journal-only verification runs) never triggers Rust/TypeScript workflows, required checks never report, auto-merge stalls forever.
resolution: PR #17 removed the pull_request paths filters so every PR reports checks; while it existed, admin-merge of vetted PRs was the escape hatch (protocol from fabro-fe0f).

content: sd ready/sd list always with --limit 200 (default 50 silently truncates below ~50 High-priority seeds); closeout reads the engine-piped seed id via 'cat | str join' and closes exactly that one seed — one seed per run.

name: revisor-gate-stop-and-salvage
description: Proven on revisor run 01M1Q7D2XXMS: 9 approved cycles salvaged via PR #20 after user stopped the loop in cycle 10.

title: Revisor autonomous short cycles (ADR-0015)
rationale: The v1 revisor loop serialized on a human approval gate per revision and revised oldest-first, producing seeds with an outdated basis from runs whose workflow definitions had drifted; 6 of 14 filed seeds were already implemented at triage time. Trusting the self-evolving process and discarding stale seeds before implementation replaces the gate as quality control; freshness is enforced mechanically via the content-derived workflow_version_id.

name: git-source-run-creation-server-side
description: In-run fabro_run_create with workflow_source {repo, branch, workflow} resolves SERVER-side through the production automation materializer (checkout -> collect -> register -> intent) with an ADR-0015 freshness pin (run target pinned to the exact resolved commit when workspace repo == workflow repo). Never build manifests from a run worker: the worker filesystem does not see the sandbox checkout. LLM-free proofs stay possible during provider budget exhaustion: run CREATION (git-source form) needs no model call — probe infrastructure with run creates + immediate cancel.

title: executor-decision-cutover-full-delegation
rationale: The develop workflow already ships engine Rust (PR #28, fabro-tool) and the conductor is cron-activated, so agent-side implementation duplicates the autonomous line and violates one-line-one-executor. User directive 2026-09-06: the agent implements NO seeds (product AND engine/platform); its role shrinks to grill/write-design-into-seeds, review, revise the autonomous line, report.

title: two-wait-tools-division-of-labor
rationale: fabro_run_gather (upstream, MCP-public, multi-run fan-in) and the new fabro_run_wait (fabro-571e, single-run long-poll with merged support) overlap; retiring gather violates the carry-upstream-forward posture, so the user split them by wait shape (ADR-0016).

content: Adding a fabro_run_* tool definition requires updating: (1) fabro-tool common::tests::shared_tool_definitions_include_run_management_catalog, (2) fabro-workflow api::tests::agent_run_tools_register_exact_shared_definitions, (3) every FabroToolBackend mock gains the required method (compiler enumerates missing impls; test-only mocks bail! with 'not supported by this mock').

Adding a fabro_run_* tool definition requires updating FOUR exact-list/static-catalog sites: (1) fabro-tool common::tests::shared_tool_definitions_include_run_management_catalog, (2) fabro-workflow api::tests::agent_run_tools_register_exact_shared_definitions, (3) fabro-validate rules/tool_catalog.rs KNOWN_FABRO_RUN_TOOL_NAMES (static list; drift test static_catalogs_match_live_crates fails in CI otherwise — the dogfood gate caught this after local suites passed, PR #31), (4) every FabroToolBackend mock gains the required method (compiler enumerates missing impls). Verification set: nextest -p fabro-tool -p fabro-workflow -p fabro-validate -p fabro-server.
